structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a Meteora pool, about 11 minutes old, for a new copy of the recycled "Mysterious Source of Income" ($INCOME) meme. It was launched at almost the same time as several other INCOME copies, and it won the volume race: about $900k traded, price up roughly 5x, about 1800 holders. The pool's LP is 100% unlocked, and bundler activity is heavy.

narrative.description: "Unemployed with a mysterious source of income" is an old meme that has been launched as a token many times. A new wave of copies appeared within minutes of each other.
narrative.why_spreading: Probably a fresh post on X set off the wave. GeckoTerminal links a deltasociety X post, but I could not read it (the page returned 402). Traders are racing between the same-minute copies.

token_connection.why_this_token: It won the volume race among the copies launched in the same minutes. It has no socials or website of its own.
token_connection.competing_tokens: The older 9PSx INCOME has $67k liquidity and a $150k market cap. At least 4 other INCOME copies were launched within minutes of this one, and many older versions exist.

authenticity.evidence: Several copies were launched within about 12 minutes of each other, which points to an outside trigger. The wallet data looks manufactured: GMGN counts 58 bundler wallets, bundlers hold 55% of top-trader volume, and bots/degens make up 52% of traders. The unique-buyer vs unique-seller split is extreme: 1777 buyers against 72 sellers.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not confirm the trigger post, and some of the buying is probably from real people.

structural_risks: The Meteora pool's LP is 100% unlocked, and the token did not launch on a launchpad
The creator has closed out and holds 0%; the LP can be pulled at any time
GMGN flags 58 bundler wallets, and bundlers hold 55% of top-trader volume
The price is already up about 5x in 11 minutes
An older canonical INCOME token has more liquidity

structured_output.counterargument: This coin clearly won the race among the same-minute clones: about $900k of volume on a $55k market cap, roughly 1800 holders, and a top-10 share near 28%. If a large account posted the trigger, the winning copy can reach $150k-300k, which is 2x or more from entry.
unknowns: What the trigger post said and who posted it
Whether the buyers are real people or bot-driven

source_coverage.notes: The linked X post returned 402. A search for the contract address found nothing. Searches for the meme found only older versions of the token.

structured_output.thesis: A recycled meme, in a clone race, on a pool whose LP is fully unlocked and whose wallets are heavily bundled. The attention is real but short-lived, and the chance of a rug is high. It has a small chance to run if the trigger was a big account.
